name: CnfSnomedShapedTestCodeSystem
title: CNF test code system, SNOMED-CT-shaped (synthetic)
description: SYNTHETIC test content. A hierarchical, numerically-coded code system SHAPED like SNOMED CT so the conformance battery can exercise is-a subsumption and value-set membership against a real FHIR R4 terminology server. It contains no SNOMED CT content and is not derived from any licensed terminology: every code and display is invented for this test corpus and lives under the reserved example.test domain (IETF RFC 6761 §6.2).
